Your son's bed...

It is empty.  Your wife is nowhere to be seen...

Has it finally changed?  Were their deaths a figment?  All a bad dream?  Is this the evening your prayers are answered?

Your browser does not support the audio tag.
That voice!  You rush back down the hallway toward your room.  Toward the voice of your son.  The blankets now hugged tight to your body to retain this new found warmth and hope.

Your browser does not support the audio tag.
You barge through the door, prepared to toss the bedsheets aside and embrace your family once more.

But...

You stop.  Frozen by fear.  By what you see.  Your son pinned to the bed by repeated strikes of the knife.  Your wife kneeling in front of your bed holding a long, bloodied knife.  She raises the knife to her throat and begins the sawing.  Back and forth.  Blood running down her arms.  Her eyes stay open, locked fearfully to yours.  You rush to her aide.  To make her stop.  You grab the knife as her head lulls backwards, eyes gaping toward the ceiling as if she were trying to look back at her dead son stuck to the bed.

You begin to weep.  You look down and see the knife in your hand.  Your arms covered in blood.

A sound from the threshold.  You spin around...

You turn on the doorway just in time to see yourself charging into the room.  You are wielding a knife.

It comes crashing down on this nightmare version of you.  Just as it pierces the skin, you shoot up in bed.  Wide awake...

Your thrashing ceases.  Your fight to free yourself from the straitjacket is fruitless.

The clock on the padded white wall reads 12:01.
